conversation.message: Mass psychogenic illness is supported by historical accounts of similar social contagions, while ergot poisoning is backed by the presence of the fungus in rye, a staple food at the time.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It's interesting to consider how scientific understanding can shed light on historical mysteries.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
